overview_description.description: A lot of schools applied smart management solutions, nevertheless no big change detected. Management software means nothing without proper strategy that puts in consideration school circumstances, goals and educational process partners. In COLNN they provide you with a team of experts that analyze your school resources, work cycle and clients’ needs, in order to customize 12 management modules of COLNN system to ensure gaining maximum benefits of applied software, highlight strengths and improve weaknesses.

product.name: School Management Software
product.description: A software system with over 12 modules designed to manage all school departments and activities, tailored to fit the school's resources and needs.

product.name: Consultancy and Development Planning Service
product.description: A consultancy service that analyzes school resources and workflows to develop customized development plans without technical or financial burdens.

identifier.value: Student Online Account and Task Management

product.name: Student Online Account and Task Management
product.description: An online platform for students to manage schedules, attendance, homework, quizzes, and receive notifications.

product.name: Digital Library
product.description: A digital library system providing access to official PDF books and files, with personal storage for students to manage their own e-books and documents.

identifier.value: Parent Online Account and Communication Platform

product.name: Parent Online Account and Communication Platform
product.description: An online system for parents to connect with the school, monitor their children's progress, and communicate with teachers and administration.

product.name: Evaluation and Feedback Communication System
product.description: A multi-channel communication system facilitating fast and accessible interaction between students, parents, and school staff for feedback and evaluation.
